inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Are overhead electric lines, utility poles, or easements shown or labeled on the proposed site plan (Sheet 9)? If yes, are clearance dimensions shown between any proposed buildings and the overhead electric conductors?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence and labeling check (do OHE lines exist on the sheet? are clearance dimensions labeled?) rather than asking for an actual measurement between features. The clearance measurement itself would come as a follow-up question if these elements are confirmed to be present.
